extracted.intended_audience: Owners/operators of new stationary sources, State/Tribal air agencies, environmental compliance officers, regulated industry, and legal/regulatory practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Table-of-contents summary of 40 CFR Part 60 (Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources) providing the structure of regulatory requirements across subparts: applicability, pollutant-specific emission standards, monitoring/test methods, performance testing, reporting, recordkeeping, state plan adoption, and related procedural provisions. Useful as a checklist of required regulatory dimensions for compliance and plan development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability and designation of affected facility
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability; designation of affected facility (e.g., §60.1; repeated for many subparts like §60.40, §60.50, §60.100, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines whether a source or piece of equipment is subject to the subpart and identifies the affected facility to which standards apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions (general and subpart-specific) (e.g., §60.2 and many subpart-specific ‘Definitions’ sections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes terms of art used to interpret applicability, standards, monitoring, and compliance provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units and abbreviations
rubrics_metrics.description: Units and abbreviations (§60.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies measurement units and abbreviations used throughout the part.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address
rubrics_metrics.description: Address (§60.4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides contact/address information for submissions or notifications where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determination of construction or modification
rubrics_metrics.description: Determination of construction or modification (§60.5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for when construction, modification, or reconstruction has occurred for applicability of standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Review of plans (§60.6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for EPA or delegated authority review of design/engineering plans relevant to compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification and recordkeeping
rubrics_metrics.description: Notification and record keeping (§60.7; general notification and reporting requirements §60.19).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial and continuing notification duties, content and timing of notices, and record retention obligations applicable across subparts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance tests
rubrics_metrics.description: Performance tests (§60.8 and many subpart-specific ‘Performance tests and compliance provisions’ sections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for conducting and reporting stack tests or other performance demonstrations to show compliance with emission limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of information
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of information (§60.9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public access or disclosure rules for information submitted under the part.

rubrics_metrics.name: State authority / Delegation of authority
rubrics_metrics.description: State authority (§60.10) and delegation/‘Delegation of authority’ provisions in many subparts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the role of State (and Tribal/local) agencies, what may be delegated, and how State implementation interacts with federal standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with standards and maintenance requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance with standards and maintenance requirements (§60.11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General obligations to meet emission limits and to maintain equipment/practices required for compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circumvention
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumvention (§60.12).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibits actions that would evade emission standards or monitoring requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring requirements / Monitoring of operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitoring requirements (§60.13 and numerous subpart-specific ‘Monitoring of operations’ sections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies continuous or periodic monitoring, parameters to monitor, frequencies, and methods to demonstrate ongoing compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modification and Reconstruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Modification (§60.14) and Reconstruction (§60.15); plus subpart-specific reconstruction provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines when changes trigger applicability of new-source standards and related compliance duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority list
rubrics_metrics.description: Priority list (§60.16).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists sources for priority review or control under the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporations by reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporations by reference (§60.17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies external standards, test methods, or reference documents incorporated into the regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: General control device and work practice requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: General control device and work practice requirements (§60.18).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work practice standards and operative requirements for control devices when numerical limits are not specified or as an alternative means.

rubrics_metrics.name: General notification and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: General notification and reporting requirements (§60.19).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content and timing for reports and notifications required by subparts and the General Provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detection sensitivity levels (Table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table 1 to Subpart A of Part 60 — Detection Sensitivity Levels (grams per hour).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies detection sensitivity thresholds used in monitoring and testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption and submittal of State plans; public hearings
rubrics_metrics.description: Adoption and submittal of State plans; public hearings (Subpart B §60.23 and related).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and public participation requirements for State plans implementing emission guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emission standards and compliance schedules
rubrics_metrics.description: Emission standards and compliance schedules (Subpart B/Ba and numerous subparts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets required emission limits and the timing for achieving compliance (deadlines, schedules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Emission inventories, source surveillance, reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Emission inventories, source surveillance, reports (§60.25 and subpart-specific equivalents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements to inventory emissions, conduct surveillance, and submit periodic reports to the Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal authority; Actions by the Administrator; Plan revisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal authority (§60.26), Actions by the Administrator (§60.27), Plan revisions (§60.28/60.29).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA authorities to act on State plans, revise plans, and the legal basis for enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emission guidelines and compliance times
rubrics_metrics.description: Emission guidelines and compliance times (Subpart C and many subparts addressing designated facilities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance that states the performance standards for existing sources and the timelines states must meet through plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operator training and qualification requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Operator training and qualification guidelines/requirements (e.g., municipal waste combustor operator training and certification §60.35b; HMIWI operator training §60.53c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training standards and certification requirements for operators to ensure proper operation and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating practices and waste management guidelines/plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Operating practices; waste management guidelines/plan (subpart-specific, e.g., municipal waste combustor operating practices, HMIWI waste management guidelines §60.35e/§60.55c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescribed operational behaviors and waste handling plans required to limit emissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emission limits for specific device classes (tables)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables specifying emissions limits for small/medium/large sources (e.g., various Table 1A/B for HMIWI, multiple tables in subparts defining numeric limits).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric emission limits by size/class of source; used to determine pass/fail for tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for particulate matter (PM)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard for particulate matter (PM) (appears in many subparts, e.g., Subpart D §60.42; Subpart E §60.52; Subpart F §60.62; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numerical emission limits and control requirements for particulate emissions from affected facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for sulfur dioxide (SO2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard for sulfur dioxide (SO2) (e.g., §60.43, §60.42b, Subpart H §60.82).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SO2 emission limits and related compliance provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for nitrogen oxides (NOX)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard for nitrogen oxides (NOX) (e.g., §60.44, Subpart D/Da/Db etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NOX emission limits, alternative standards (combined NOX/CO), and compliance provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for carbon monoxide (CO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard for carbon monoxide (CO) (e.g., Subpart J §60.103).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CO emission limitations and testing/monitoring requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for volatile organic compounds (VOC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for volatile organic compounds (VOC) (e.g., Subparts K/Ka/Kb, EE, RR, SS, TT, WW).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: VOC limits, work practice or equipment standards, monitoring, and test methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for sulfur oxides and acid mist
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for sulfur oxides and acid mist (Subpart J §60.104; Subpart H §60.83).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric or work-practice standards for sulfur species and acid mist emissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for visible emissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard for visible emissions (e.g., Subpart P §60.164; Subpart Q §60.174; Subpart R §60.184).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opacity/visible emissions standards and methods for observation/compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for lead and other metallic pollutants
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for lead (e.g., Subpart KK §60.372) and other metallic pollutants in specific subparts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric emission limits and monitoring/reporting for heavy metal emissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for fluorides and TRS (total reduced sulfur)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for fluorides (Subparts S, T, U, V) and TRS (Subpart BB §60.283).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pollutant-specific limits and monitoring for fluoride and reduced sulfur compounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for organics, acid gases, and nitrogen oxides for municipal waste combustors
rubrics_metrics.description: Emissions guidelines for municipal waste combustor metals, acid gases, organics, and nitrogen oxides (Subpart Cb §60.33b and related).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets pollutant-specific limits and operating practices for combustors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring and emission monitoring for specific units (FCCU, FCU, sulfur recovery, flares)
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitoring of emissions and operations for fluid catalytic cracking units (FCCU), fluid coking units (FCU), sulfur recovery plants, fuel gas combustion devices and flares (e.g., Subpart Ja §§60.105a-60.107a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies monitoring parameters, frequencies, and approved methods for those unit types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test methods and procedures; reference methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Test methods and procedures (numerous subparts and Appendices A-1 through A-8 listing Methods 1–30B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescribes approved test methods, sampling procedures, and calculation methods for demonstrating compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance specifications and quality assurance procedures (Appendices B, F)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix B Performance Specifications; Appendix F Quality Assurance Procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical performance requirements and QA/QC obligations for monitoring equipment and data quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recordkeeping and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Recordkeeping and reporting requirements (numerous subparts; e.g., §60.51, §60.58a, §60.59a, §60.47b, §60.48b, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: What records to keep, retention periods, report formats/frequency, and submission procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance and performance test methods and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance and performance test methods and procedures (appears in multiple subparts: e.g., §§60.46, 60.58a, 60.58b, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How to conduct performance tests, test conditions, and data reporting to demonstrate compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emission capture system efficiency; add-on control device destruction efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Emission capture system efficiency; add-on control device destruction efficiency (e.g., Subpart MMa Table 1, Subpart MMa §60.396a-§60.397a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric operating limits and efficiency requirements for capture systems and control devices used to meet source limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial compliance and continuous compliance demonstration
rubrics_metrics.description: How to demonstrate initial compliance and continuous compliance with standards (e.g., §§60.5410–60.5416 in multiple subparts and model rule sections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for initial testing/notifications and ongoing monitoring, data collection, and demonstrations of continued compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial and continuous cover and closed vent system inspection and monitoring requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for inspection and monitoring of covers and closed vent systems (multiple OOOO/OOOOa/OOOOc/Model Rule sections §60.5411/§60.5416 etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspection intervals, monitoring parameters, and corrective actions for closed vent systems and covers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous monitoring requirements for control devices
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuous monitoring requirements for control devices (§60.5417 and subpart-specific sections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies continuous parameters to record (e.g., temperatures, pressures) and performance thresholds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification, reports, and records specific requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: What notifications must be submitted and when; what reports must be submitted and when; what records must be maintained (many sections: e.g., §§60.5550–60.5565, §60.5420).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers timing, content, and recipients of required administrative submissions to EPA or delegated agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative standards and equivalence of means of emission limitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternative standards and equivalence of means of emission limitation (§60.484/§60.484a and many subpart alternatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and procedures for using alternative means or technologies to meet standards, including equivalency demonstrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative standards for valves and leak-detection/repair strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternative standards for valves—allowable percentage of valves leaking; skip period leak detection and repair (§60.483-1/§60.483-2 and variants in a/b/c subparts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative compliance paths for fugitive emissions components based on leak percentages or periodic monitoring strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay of repair; repair criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for delay of repair (§60.482-9 and variants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When and how long repairs may be delayed, and documentation required to justify delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closed vent systems and control devices standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for closed vent systems and control devices (§60.482-10 and variants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design, operation, monitoring, and performance criteria for closed vent systems as emission control measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconstruction provisions and applicability related to reconstruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Reconstruction provisions (§60.15 and numerous subpart reconstruction sections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How reconstruction is defined and when reconstructed sources must meet new-source standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affirmative defense for violations during malfunction
rubrics_metrics.description: Affirmative defense for violations of emission standards during malfunction (present in some subparts, e.g., §60.286a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Circumstances and procedural steps under which a source may assert an affirmative defense for excess emissions caused by malfunctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Siting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Siting requirements (e.g., Subpart Eb §60.57b; Subpart Ec §60.54c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Location-based provisions and constraints for specific facility types (e.g., public health/proximity considerations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Operator labeling and owner's manuals requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner's manuals and temporary labels for wood heaters and appliance certification requirements (Appendix I to Part 60; Subpart QQQQ §60.5478 etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Labeling, manual content, and consumer information requirements for certain residential/consumer devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test method appendices (Appendix A series)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix A-1 through A-8 listing Test Methods 1–30B (Appendix A-1: Test Methods 1–2F; through Appendix A-8: Methods 26–30B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed standardized sampling and analytical methods referenced by subparts for measurements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determination of emission rate change and required emission inventory information (Appendices C & D)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix C Determination of Emission Rate Change; Appendix D Required Emission Inventory Information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methods for calculating emission rate changes and minimum emission inventory data elements to be reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance specifications and appendices for alternative demonstration
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix B Performance Specifications; Appendix G Provisions for an Alternative Method of Demonstrating Compliance (example provisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical specifications and allowed alternative demonstrations for compliance in limited cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model rule, increments of progress, and state/Tribal plan components
rubrics_metrics.description: Model rule—principal components, increments of progress, applicability, emission and work practice standards, test methods, compliance schedules, state/Tribal plan elements (Subpart OOOOc/OOOOc Model Rule sections §§60.5376c–60.5388c etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for state/Tribal plan content and model-rule structure that states may adopt to meet 111(d) or emission guideline obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to review emission guidelines for coal-fired affected EGUs and State plan timing and revision procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Commitment to review emission guidelines; what must be included in state plans; timing requirements for submitting and revising state plans (e.g., §§60.5795b, §§60.5785b–60.5790b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA and State obligations to review, submit, and revise plans and to establish timetables for compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who implements and enforces the subpart
rubrics_metrics.description: Who implements and enforces this subpart (subpart-specific enforcement/implementation sections e.g., §60.5575, §60.5482).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies which government entity (EPA, State, or Tribal) has primary enforcement responsibility.
